candidates.term: The Sage at the Year Gate
candidates.defline: The Sage stands at your Year Gate, in plain view: as a child you were seen to be well looked after and well taught.
candidates.reading: Someone with clear principles raised you, and it showed early in your manners and in the way you spoke to adults. Because learning was valued at home, teachers took to you early, and help arrived each time you needed it. Older people still trust you on sight. You expect shelter to appear when things go wrong, and you are slower than most to build your own.
candidates.teaser: You were sheltered by someone principled, and it shows in your bearing. Learning is your inheritance: credentials, teachers, and timely protection keep appearing across your life.

domain_readings.Family: You were sheltered by someone principled and it shows in your bearing: the protection of your early years installed a baseline trust most people have to construct. Family remains your first reference for safety. Repay the shelter forward. It was always meant to travel.
domain_readings.Mind: Learning is your inheritance: credentials, teachers, timely knowledge arriving just before you needed it. Your mind was raised expecting to be taught, and it kept the posture. Stay a student in every decade. The inheritance pays out only while enrolled.

candidates.life_chapter: Your early chapter was gently guarded: a principled protector, a house with books, safety arriving before you knew to want it. Those years installed your deep settings, trust, learning, decency. Expect protectors to keep appearing lifelong. You were trained to deserve them.
candidates.relations: The principled shelterer is this seat’s person: a mother, a mentor, an elder whose steadiness became your first floor. Their protection shaped your bearing. Shelter someone the same way, unasked, without invoice. That completes the circuit they opened.
candidates.turn_catalyst: Run thin, the shelter goes unclaimed: help nearby, requests unfiled. Ask a mentor for one thing this month. The inheritance activates on asking.
candidates.turn_friction: Run heavy, the shelter becomes the ceiling: protected past the point of growing. Step outside the umbrella deliberately.
candidates.shadow_line: Overloaded, trust waits for rescue: capability paused until someone arrives.
candidates.health_line: Your constitution responds to care like a garden to rain: tended, it flourishes visibly. Accept the tending. Self-sufficiency is not the assignment here.

Family.headline: You grew up protected by someone principled.
Family.recognition: The steady, decent care you had early is the measure you hold family to, and you notice quickly when it is missing. Because your first home gave you safety and clear values, you trust family as the place to turn first. You judge a relative by whether they keep their word, and you say so when they do not.
Family.lived: Your first home ran on care and clear rules, kept by a parent or older relative who held everyone to a high standard. By your teens you had their sense of right and wrong, and people outside the family noticed it in you.

Mind.headline: You were raised to learn, and you still do.
Mind.recognition: You approach a new subject expecting to be taught well, and you go looking for the best teacher before you open a book. Because books and patient adults were part of your childhood, you learn easily inside a course or a school, and you value a qualification for its own sake. You find it harder to learn where nobody is guiding you.
Mind.lived: As a child you had books at home and adults who answered your questions, and school came easily. By your teens a teacher or older relative had taken a special interest in you, and you worked harder because of it.

The Sage stood openly at your Year Gate: you were sheltered by someone principled, and it shows in your bearing to this day. Learning is your inheritance, credentials, teachers, timely protection that kept arriving just before you needed it. The family gave you a moral spine and a library card, in whatever form. Expect that pattern to continue: elders, mentors, and doors that open on reputation. Repay it forward rather than backward. Shelter given is how this inheritance stays alive.
